Label: Purpose
Is Replaced By: To point to the record(s) that replace the withdrawn one.

Label: Entry Guidelines
Is Replaced By: Enter the ID of each replacement record.

Label: Commentary
Is Replaced By: Mirrors [Is Replaced By](../ogm-aardvark/#is-replaced-by) (`dct_isReplacedBy_sm`). If you are keeping the old record published, don't withdraw it. Instead, list it in [Replaces](../ogm-aardvark/#replaces) on the newer record, which is the field GeoBlacklight uses to link the two.
